---

{{ if .Vars.win11cis_level_2 }}
  {{ if .Vars.win11cis_rule_2_3_7_7 }}
registry:
  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\CachedLogonsCount:
    title: "2.3.7.7 | Ensure 'Interactive logon: Number of previous logons to cache (in case domain controller is not available)' is set to '4 or fewer logon(s)' | CachedLogonsCount"
    exists: true
    value: '{{ .Vars.win11cis_cached_logons_count }}'
    type: REG_SZ
    meta:
      workstation: 2
      CIS_ID:
        - 2.3.7.7
  {{ end }}
{{ end }}

discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_2/cis_2.3.7.x.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS` and Audit control `section_2/cis_2.3.7.x/cis_2.3.7.7.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

Manual: the Ansible role applies this only under conditions we cannot translate into a check, so it is shown as the original Ansible and goss test.

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "2.3.7.7 | PATCH | Ensure 'Interactive logon: Number of previous logons to cache (in case domain controller is not available)' is set to '4 or fewer logon(s)'"
  when: win11cis_rule_2_3_7_7
  tags:
    - level2-high-security-sensitive-data-environment
    - patch
    - automated
    - rule_2.3.7.7
  block:
    - name: "2.3.7.7 | PATCH | Ensure 'Interactive logon: Number of previous logons to cache (in case domain controller is not available)' is set to '4 or fewer logon(s) | Apply Settings To Registry"
      when: win11cis_cached_logons_count <= 4
      ansible.windows.win_regedit:
        path: HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows Nt\Currentversion\Winlogon
        name: CachedLogonsCount
        data: "{{ win11cis_cached_logons_count }}"
        type: string

    - name: "2.3.7.7 | AUDIT | Ensure 'Interactive logon: Number of previous logons to cache (in case domain controller is not available)' is set to '4 or fewer logon(s) | Warning Check For Variable Standards"
      when: win11cis_cached_logons_count > 4
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Warning!! You have an invalid number of logons set for win11cis_cached_logons_count. Please read"
          - "the notes for the variable and make the necessary change to the variable to be in compliance."

    - name: "2.3.7.7 | AUDIT | Ensure 'Interactive logon: Number of previous logons to cache (in case domain controller is not available)' is set to '4 or fewer logon(s) | Warn Count"
      when: win11cis_cached_logons_count > 4
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '2.3.7.7'
